python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

# Test the exact example from the requirement
request = {
  "pipeline": {"steps": [
    {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "customer_lifetime_value_including_all_historic_orders_and_refunds"]}
  ]},
  "dataset": []
}

result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "etl_pipeline.py"],
    input=json.dumps(request),
    text=True,
    capture_output=True
)

output = json.loads(result.stdout)
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))

# Verify the response matches the expected format
assert output["status"] == "error"
assert output["error_code"] == "SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED"
assert "must be at most 64 characters" in output["message"]
assert output["path"] == "pipeline.steps[0].columns[1]"
print("\nAll assertions passed!")
EOF
